title: A surjective endomorphism of a finite module is an isomorphism
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M$ a finite (finitely generated) $R$-module and $\varphi:M\to M$ a surjective $R$-linear map. Then $\varphi$ is an isomorphism.
